content.short: Superform is a universal yield marketplace that enables one-click access to any vault on any supported chain.
content.description: Superform is a pioneering decentralized yield marketplace and cross-chain router designed to simplify the multi-chain investment experience. The platform allows users to discover and access over 800 earning opportunities from top-tier protocols—such as Aave, Morpho, and Pendle—using any token on any supported chain in a single, unified transaction. By utilizing its proprietary 'SuperPositions' (ERC-1155 tokens), Superform enables participants to manage their diversified yield positions across the entire Web3 ecosystem. The protocol optimizes liquidity routing to ensure the best execution.
content.meta: Superform provides a universal yield marketplace and cross-chain router for one-click access. Discover Superform on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
